description: Replaces the Hubitat Echo Speaks rule "Someone's home! (A)". Fires on presence arrival (sensor off -> on), before they are through the door - phrasing says arrived/here, never 'walked in' or 'entered the building'. Suppressed entirely while Silence Voice Alerts is on. Waits 3 seconds then announces on Alexa Pup, Office Dog and Bedroom Dot via Alexa Media Player. Announces only once if both arrive together - a second arrival within 2 minutes is ignored. The Hubitat rule was disabled 2026-09-29 when this took over.

triggers.note: Hubitat presence sensor mirrored into HA via Maker API.

conditions.note: Master mute. light.silence_voice_alerts is a switch_as_x mirror of this switch - toggling either one works.

actions.note: Matches the 3-second delay configured in the original Echo Speaks action.
Re-checked after the delay so toggling Silence Voice Alerts on right as someone arrives still suppresses the announcement.

data.message:
{% set name = trigger.id %}{% set phrases = [
  "Turn up the AC, it's about to get hot in here. " ~ name ~ " is back!",
  "Guess who's back, back again? " ~ name ~ "'s back, tell a friend!",
  "Attention, attention! The one, the only, " ~ name ~ " has returned. Please hold your applause until the end.",
  "Alert! " ~ name ~ " has arrived. Hide the snacks, or be prepared to share!",
  "Look who's back! " ~ name ~ ", the one person who always laughs at your jokes, even the bad ones.",
  "Everyone act natural. " ~ name ~ " is here.",
  "Breaking news: " ~ name ~ " is here. Back to you in the studio.",
  "Ladies and gentlemen, please rise. " ~ name ~ " has arrived.",
  "The prodigal " ~ name ~ " returns. Someone fetch the good snacks.",
  "Incoming. " ~ name ~ " is home, and statistically speaking, hungry.",
  "Security alert. Intruder detected. False alarm, it's just " ~ name ~ ".",
  "" ~ name ~ " has docked successfully. All systems nominal. Welcome home.",
  "Roll out the red carpet. Actually, we don't have one. Just come in, " ~ name ~ ".",
  "" ~ name ~ " is home. You may all resume whatever you were doing. Or don't. I'm not in charge here.",
  "Look alive, people. " ~ name ~ " is here and will absolutely notice the dishes."
] %}{{ phrases | random }}

actions.note: trigger.id carries the arriving person's name into the phrase list. 15 phrases, randomly selected. Wording says arrived/here - avoid any phrasing that claims they are already inside the house. Multiple targets play as a synchronized broadcast.
Cooldown: holds the run open so a second arrival within 2 minutes is swallowed by mode single. Announces once when Tim and Emily come home together.
